name: Angsana Corfu Resort & Spa
insider_take: This Banyan Tree jewel sits on Corfu's pristine Benitses Bay, where Venetian elegance meets modern luxury in one of Greece's most storied islands.
whats_special: The resort occupies a prime hillside location overlooking the Ionian Sea, just 12km from Corfu's UNESCO World Heritage Old Town. Corfu is uniquely the only Greek island never conquered by the Ottomans, creating a distinctive blend of Venetian, French, and British architectural influences that you won't find elsewhere in Greece.
pro_tip: Visit nearby Achilleion Palace (15 minutes away), the former summer retreat of Empress Elisabeth of Austria, featuring stunning neoclassical architecture and gardens with panoramic island views.
dont_miss: The resort's signature Angsana Spa treatments and the short trip to Corfu Town's famous Liston Promenade - inspired by Paris's Rue de Rivoli and perfect for evening strolls with traditional kumquat liqueur tastings.
pros: Award-winning Angsana Spa with signature Asian wellness treatments
Stunning beachfront location on Corfu's pristine coastline
Luxurious accommodations with modern Greek island design
Multiple dining venues featuring Mediterranean and international cuisine
cons: Remote island location requires flight connections
Premium pricing for luxury resort experience
